title: If a seaman contravenes sub-section
text:
42. If a seaman contravenes sub-section

(3) of section 135.

131 Fine which may extend
to one hundred rupees.

133 Fine which may extend
to fifty rupees.

135(3) Imprisonment which

may extend to one
month, or fine which
may extend to one
hundred rupees, or

both, but nothing

herein shall take away
or limit any other
remedy which any

person would

otherwise have for

breach of contract or
refund of the money
advanced or otherwise.

138A Fine which may extend
to double the average
wages per hour

payable to the seaman
for working beyond
forty-eight hours.]

General 2[Penalty which may
extend to two lakh
rupees.]

151 3[Penalty which may

extend to fifty thousand
rupees.]
